{"settings":"{
  "workbench.colorTheme": "GitHub Dark Default",
  "editor.fontFamily": "JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, monospace",
  "editor.fontLigatures": false,
  "editor.fontSize": 16,
  "editor.lineHeight": 30,
  "editor.fontWeight": "bold",
  "editor.smoothScrolling": true,
  "workbench.list.smoothScrolling": true,
  "editor.renderWhitespace": "selection",
  "editor.guides.bracketPairs": true,
  "editor.guides.bracketPairsHorizontal": true,
  "editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled": true,
  "editor.stickyScroll.enabled": false,
  "editor.inlayHints.enabled": "off",
  "editor.linkedEditing": true,
  "editor.wordWrap": "wordWrapColumn",
  "editor.wordWrapColumn": 120,
  "editor.snippetSuggestions": "top",
  "editor.suggestSelection": "recentlyUsedByPrefix",
  "editor.detectIndentation": false,
  "editor.tabSize": 2,
  "explorer.fileNesting.enabled": true,
  "explorer.fileNesting.patterns": {
    "package.json": "package-lock.json, .npmrc, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml",
    "tsconfig.json": "tsconfig.*.json",
    "*.ts": "${capture}.js",
  },
  "explorer.confirmDragAndDrop": false,
  "explorer.confirmDelete": false,
  "files.trimTrailingWhitespace": true,
  "files.insertFinalNewline": true,
  "files.trimFinalNewlines": true,
  "workbench.editor.limit.value": 15,
  "workbench.startupEditor": "none",
  "window.nativeFullScreen": true,
  "workbench.activityBar.location": "top",
  "workbench.sideBar.location": "right",
  "workbench.tree.indent": 24,
  "editor.minimap.enabled": true,
  "editor.minimap.maxColumn": 200,
  "terminal.integrated.fontSize": 15,
  "terminal.integrated.cursorBlinking": true,
  "terminal.integrated.cursorStyle": "line",
  "terminal.integrated.gpuAcceleration": "on",
  "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode",
  "[javascript]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "vscode.typescript-language-features",
  },
  "[typescript]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "vscode.typescript-language-features",
  },
  "[javascriptreact]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "vscode.typescript-language-features",
  },
  "[cpp]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "llvm-vs-code-extensions.vscode-clangd",
  },
  "[html]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "vscode.html-language-features",
  },
  "[css]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "vscode.css-language-features",
  },
  "[json]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "vscode.json-language-features",
  },
  "css.lint.unknownVendorSpecificProperties": "ignore",
  "emmet.triggerExpansionOnTab": true,
  "emmet.includeLanguages": {
    "javascript": "javascriptreact",
    "vue-html": "html",
    "blade": "html",
  },
  "code-runner.clearPreviousOutput": true,
  "code-runner.saveFileBeforeRun": true,
  "code-runner.runInTerminal": true,
  "code-runner.showExecutionMessage": false,
  "code-runner.executorMap": {
    "javascript": "node",
    "java": "cd $dir && javac $fileName && java $fileNameWithoutExt",
    "c": "cd $dir && gcc $fileName -o $fileNameWithoutExt && $dir$fileNameWithoutExt",
    "cpp": "cd $dir && g++-16 -std=c++20 $fileName -o $fileNameWithoutExt && $dir$fileNameWithoutExt",
    "python": "clear && python3 -u",
    "dart": "dart",
    "go": "go run",
    "rust": "cd $dir && rustc $fileName && $dir$fileNameWithoutExt",
  },
  "search.exclude": {
    ".phpunit.result.cache": true,
    "**/.DS_Store": true,
    "**/.git": true,
    "**/build": true,
    "**/composer.lock": true,
    "**/dist": true,
    "**/node_modules": true,
    "**/package-lock.json": true,
    "**/vendor": true
  },
  "[svelte]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "svelte.svelte-vscode",
  },
  "workbench.secondarySideBar.defaultVisibility": "hidden",
  "explorer.compactFolders": false,
  "scm.compactFolders": false,
  "notebook.compactView": false,
  "workbench.tree.expandMode": "doubleClick",
  "css.lint.duplicateProperties": "warning",
  "css.lint.float": "warning",
  "python.analysis.typeCheckingMode": "standard",
  "terminal.integrated.enableMultiLinePasteWarning": "never",
  "files.watcherExclude": {
    "**/.git/**": true,
    "**/node_modules/**": true,
    "**/dist/**": true,
    "**/build/**": true,
    "**/.next/**": true,
    "**/.svelte-kit/**": true,
    "**/target/**": true,
  },
  "js/ts.tsserver.maxMemory": 1024,
  "git.autofetch": false,
  "git.confirmSync": false,
  "extensions.experimental.affinity": {
    "github.copilot": 1,
  },
  "update.showReleaseNotes": false,
  "workbench.tips.enabled": false,
  "workbench.enableExperiments": false,
  "workbench.settings.enableNaturalLanguageSearch": false,
  "workbench.settings.openDefaultKeybindings": false,
  "editor.renderLineHighlight": "line",
  "editor.renderControlCharacters": false,
  "editor.scrollBeyondLastLine": false,
  "editor.fastScrollSensitivity": 10,
  "editor.mouseWheelZoom": false,
  "editor.hover.delay": 0,
  "editor.hover.enabled": "on",
  "editor.lightbulb.enabled": "on",
  "editor.matchBrackets": "always",
  "editor.rename.enablePreview": false,
  "editor.selectionHighlight": true,
  "editor.semanticHighlighting.enabled": true,
  "editor.unicodeHighlight.invisibleCharacters": false,
  "editor.unicodeHighlight.ambiguousCharacters": false,
  "editor.quickSuggestions": {
    "other": true,
    "comments": false,
    "strings": false
  },
  "editor.suggest.showIcons": true,
  "editor.suggest.showStatusBar": false,
  "editor.suggest.preview": true,
  "editor.suggest.localityBonus": true,
  "editor.suggest.snippetsPreventQuickSuggestions": false,
  "editor.acceptSuggestionOnCommitCharacter": false,
  "search.useIgnoreFiles": true,
  "search.useGlobalIgnoreFiles": true,
  "search.smartCase": true,
  "search.showLineNumbers": true,
  "search.followSymlinks": false,
  "explorer.incrementalNaming": "smart",
  "explorer.sortOrder": "type",
  "workbench.editor.revealIfOpen": true,
  "workbench.editor.closeOnFileDelete": true,
  "terminal.integrated.enablePersistentSessions": false,
  "terminal.integrated.allowChords": false,
  "terminal.integrated.tabs.enabled": true,
  "terminal.integrated.confirmOnExit": "never",
  "git.enabled": true,
  "git.autorefresh": false,
  "git.showProgress": false,
  "git.mergeEditor": false,
  "git.openRepositoryInParentFolders": "never",
  "editor.formatOnSave": false,
  "editor.formatOnPaste": false,
  "editor.formatOnType": false,
  "prettier.enableDebugLogs": false,
  "prettier.requireConfig": true,
  "prettier.useEditorConfig": true,
  "prettier.prettierPath": "node_modules/prettier",
  "svelte.enable-ts-plugin": true,
  "svelte.plugin.css.diagnostics.enable": false,
  "svelte.plugin.svelte.format.enable": true,
  "js/ts.updateImportsOnFileMove.enabled": "never",
  "js/ts.suggest.completeFunctionCalls": true,
  "js/ts.suggest.autoImports": true,
  "js/ts.referencesCodeLens.enabled": false,
  "js/ts.implementationsCodeLens.enabled": false,
  "python.analysis.indexing": false,
  "python.analysis.autoImportCompletions": true,
  "python.terminal.activateEnvironment": false,
  "C_Cpp.intelliSenseEngine": "disabled",
  "C_Cpp.intelliSenseEngineFallback": "disabled",
  "C_Cpp.autocompleteAddParentheses": true,
  "html.autoCreateQuotes": false,
  "html.autoClosingTags": true,
  "css.validate": true,
  "extensions.ignoreRecommendations": true,
  "breadcrumbs.enabled": false,
  "debug.showBreakpointsInOverviewRuler": false,
  "editor.guides.indentation": true,
  "emmet.showSuggestionsAsSnippets": true,
  "editor.tabCompletion": "on",
  "explorer.confirmPasteNative": false,
  "workbench.editorAssociations": {
    "*.copilotmd": "vscode.markdown.preview.editor",
    "*.svg": "imagePreview.previewEditor"
  },
  "workbench.editor.enablePreview": false,
  "chat.mcp.gallery.enabled": true,
  "workbench.editor.historyBasedLanguageDetection": false,
  "workbench.editor.languageDetection": false,
  "workbench.editor.languageDetectionHints": {
    "untitledEditors": false,
    "notebookEditors": false
  },
  "terminal.integrated.initialHint": false,
  "lldb.suppressUpdateNotifications": true,
  "[snippets]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "vscode.json-language-features"
  },
  "editor.maxTokenizationLineLength": 400000,
  "workbench.settings.applyToAllProfiles": [
    "editor.maxTokenizationLineLength",
    "C_Cpp_Runner.cppStandard",
    "chat.editing.autoAcceptDelay"
  ],
  "editor.hover.showLongLineWarning": false,
  "editor.largeFileOptimizations": false,
  "files.exclude": {
    "**/.git": true,
    "**/.svn": true,
    "**/.hg": true,
    "**/.DS_Store": true,
    "**/Thumbs.db": true,
  },
  "editor.quickSuggestionsDelay": 0,
  "extensions.autoUpdateDelay": 3,
  "indentRainbow.updateDelay": 0,
  "C_Cpp.codeFolding": "disabled",
  "C_Cpp.vcFormat.indent.braces": true,
  "files.associations": {
    "*.json": "jsonc"
  },
  "C_Cpp.copilotHover": "disabled",
  "editor.parameterHints.enabled": false,
  "chat.titleBar.openInAgentsWindow.enabled": false,
  "workbench.browser.showInTitleBar": false,
  "workbench.layoutControl.enabled": false,
  "C_Cpp.intelliSenseUpdateDelay": 500,
  "C_Cpp.maxCachedProcesses": 4,
  "C_Cpp.default.cppStandard": "c++20",
  "http.systemCertificatesNode": true,
  "workbench.editorLargeFileConfirmation": 128,
  "workbench.editor.autoLockGroups": {
    "mainThreadWebview-browserPreview": false,
    "mainThreadWebview-simpleBrowser.view": false
  },
  "workbench.editor.focusRecentEditorAfterClose": false,
  "editor.find.addExtraSpaceOnTop": false,
  "diffEditor.codeLens": true,
  "editor.suggest.showEnumMembers": false,
  "editor.suggest.showEnums": false,
  "workbench.commandPalette.history": 80,
  "window.commandCenter": false,
  "explorer.decorations.badges": false,
  "explorer.decorations.colors": false,
  "telemetry.feedback.enabled": false,
  "telemetry.editStats.enabled": false,
  "terminal.integrated.hideOnStartup": "always",
  "markdown.preview.doubleClickToSwitchToEditor": true,
  "markdown.preview.fontSize": 18,
  "markdown.preview.markEditorSelection": true,
  "editor.suggest.shareSuggestSelections": true,
  "terminal.integrated.sendKeybindingsToShell": true,
  "editor.suggest.showDeprecated": false,
  "clangd.checkUpdates": true,
  "clangd.arguments": [
    "--query-driver=/opt/homebrew/bin/g++-16",
  ],
  "editor.cursorBlinking": "smooth",
  "editor.cursorSmoothCaretAnimation": "on",
  "workbench.editor.empty.hint": "hidden",
  "editor.autoIndentOnPaste": true,
  "chat.editRequests": "hover",
  "chat.inlineReferences.style": "link",
  "chat.tools.todos.showWidget": false,
  // "workbench.colorCustomizations": {
    //   "editorError.foreground": "#00000000",
    //   "editorWarning.foreground": "#00000000",
    //   "editorInfo.foreground": "#00000000"
    // }
    "chat.editing.autoAcceptDelay": 0.1,
    "chat.editing.confirmEditRequestRemoval": false,
    "chat.editing.confirmEditRequestRetry": false,
    "chat.editing.revealNextChangeOnResolve": false,
    "github.copilot.enable": {
      "*": true,
      "plaintext": false,
      "markdown": false,
      "scminput": false,
      "cpp": false
    },
    "workbench.colorCustomizations": {
      "inlineChat.regionHighlight": "#00000000",
      "inlineChatDiff.inserted": "#00000000",
      "inlineChatDiff.removed": "#00000000",
      "diffEditor.insertedTextBackground": "#00000000",
      "diffEditor.removedTextBackground": "#00000000"
    },
    "security.workspace.trust.untrustedFiles": "open",
    "github.copilot.chat.exploreAgent.enabled": false,
    "workbench.iconTheme": "catppuccin-macchiato"
  }"}
